featureName.description:
The name of the asset-level {@link Feature} for which you want to select the most associated
{@link Sensor}s.

associationType.description:
{@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationJob#getAssociationRuns} returns {@link Sensor} associations
with two pieces of information, i.e., `associationStrength` and `associationStrengthDirectional`.
`associationStrength` is simply the magnitude of `associationStrengthDirectional`, where
association may sometimes be negative. For example, pearson correlation coefficient can be negative.
Use this field to indicate how to select the top {@link Sensor}s, should the selection be based on
the magnitude of association or the association with the directionality.

associationRange.description:
The threshold range on the `associationStrength` or `associationStrengthDirectional`
for selecting top associated {@link Sensor}s.

NOTE: The lower of the two values must always be provided as the first value in the pair.

topN.description:
If the top {@link Sensor}s should be selected based on simply the top
`n` {@link Sensor}s ranked by `associationStrength` or `associationStrengthDirectional`,
then set this field to an integer value. If {@link #associationRange}
is specified already, then `topN` is applied to the sensors after they are filtered based
on the `associationRange.`

Notice that it is possible that even if only `topN` is specified, it is possible that
less than `topN` sensors are selected if the number of sensors with
non-NaN association scores is less than `topN`.

Note: use topN < 0 if you want to select all the sensors filtered by {@link #associationRange}.

title:
Use options from this Type to invoke {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorAssociationRun#selectTopSensorsForAsset}.
A combination of {@link associationRange} and {@link topN}, will be used to select sensors. If both are provided,
then first {@link Sensor}s are filtered based on the cutoff {@link associationRange}, and if there are more than
 {@link topN} sensors remaining, then the top `n` sensors are selected from the filterd list.

Example 1:
If we set {@link #associationRange} to `c3.Pair.ofDbl(0.7, 0.9)`, {@link #topN} is 20 and 15 sensors have correlations
between 0.7 and 0.9, then 15 sensors are returned.

Example 2:
If we set {@link #associationRange} to `c3.Pair.ofDbl(0.7, 0.9)`, {@link #topN} is 20 and 25 sensors have correlations
between 0.7 and 0.9, then the top 20 correlated sensors are returned.
name: ReliabilityAssetSensorSelectionSpec
